label: SCOTRESP: fourteen or more steroid-containing inhalers in the last year
title: Fourteen or more steroid-containing inhalers in the last year
statement: Patients prescribed 14 or more ICS in last 12 months

plain_summary: A supply of at least 14 inhalers containing a corticosteroid in the last year prompts a review of device quantities and the treatment plan.

medicine_groups.name: Inhaled corticosteroid inhalers
medicine_groups.note: Check each inhaler's ingredients, including dual and triple combinations and as-needed inhalers. Exclude nasal, oral and nebulised products. One 30-capsule Atectura Breezhaler carton supplies one inhaler device. Count each combination device once. Use device quantities directly or convert packs or capsules using confirmed pack contents. One 30-capsule Enerzair pack supplies one device. Record and exclude unclear quantities. Exclude puffs and unfilled repeats.

rule_for_models: The application has counted the Group A corticosteroid inhalers supplied in the last 12 months counted back from the latest date in the record: read the paragraph that begins COUNTED BY THE APPLICATION. It lists every supply line counted with its number of inhaler devices, and the total supplied. Only packs supplied for inhalation with an inhaler device qualify for the capsule conversion. A verified pack recorded as 30 capsules counts as one device. Oral budesonide capsules add no devices. Do not count again. Suspect a finding when the total supplied is 14 or more, and cite every line that the paragraph lists. When the total supplied is 13 or less, give no finding. If the paragraph names a line whose quantity was not read, tell the pharmacist which line it is and ask how many inhalers it held.
cannot_be_seen: The number of devices used can vary with device size, directions and use for both maintenance and relief. Supply alone cannot show the dose actually taken, adherence or excessive use. Ask how the inhaler is actually used, whether it serves for both maintenance and relief, and how many spare devices the patient keeps.
ask_the_gp: Could we review the number of devices supplied against their size, the prescribed maintenance and reliever doses, and the patient's action plan?
